{{Quote|Those 631s are not the brightest lights on the ship.|This droid speaking to a fellow one about the inferior capabilities of the 631 model|audio=NotTheBrightestLights-DotD.flac|<ref name="DOD">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>}}
A '[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|''B1-Series battle droid''']] was stationed in the [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] on the [[Ruusan 2/Legends|moon]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] and served under command of [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managed to trace the location of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], the [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], and sent a clone strike team lead by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|take it out]].

Meanwhile on the station, this droid along with three others were chatting, this one giving a [[631/Legends|631]] model B1 battle droid an important object to carry to another level without dropping it. When the droid failed to accomplish the task and dropped the object, this droid expressed his disappointment towards the intelligence of the 631 model with a fellow droid.

This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was eventually destroyed along with the whole squadron of droids when the Republic forces detonated the explosives they had planted on the station, destroying it.
